state_definitions.allowed_wording: best result among all fully qualified methods in the frozen Phase-9 matched deployable registry

mandatory baseline removed or ineligible after promotion
denominator/task signature/observation/action/compute contract changed
simultaneous CI or independent backend/recompute gate fails
missingness, timeout, control cost or postselection omitted

same-task signature or external evaluator mismatch
registered-best prerequisite is revoked

six-state denominator, censoring, reset/control cost or failure rows omitted
